dossiers.title: Hardspace: Shipbreaker
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 9 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Repeatedly praised salvage gameplay involves inspecting hulls, cutting connections, maneuvering wreckage in zero gravity and delivering components to distinct material processors.
Zero-gravity positioning and grapple-tool handling allow precise dismantling, but simultaneous object interactions can require adjustment.
Timed salvage shifts, recurring operating charges and corporate debt connect job efficiency with unlocks, but later gear upgrades can feel incremental.
Fuel, electricity, reactors and decompression hazards make safe dismantling a planning challenge where mistakes may destroy valuable salvage.
Players who reached the full-release midgame and endgame report repeated ship body layouts and similar dismantling routines despite internal variations.
Some players find the repetitive salvage routine relaxing and absorbing, while others find the same extended work loop tedious.
The work is centered on repeated contracts in one orbital salvage bay rather than free-flight exploration or traveling between areas.
Some players criticize prolonged unskippable campaign dialogue and a didactic corporate storyline that interrupt hands-on salvaging.
A Russian-language release-era player review objected to interface translation formatting and fonts; these dated reports do not resolve present-day localization quality.

conflicts.statement: Some players find salvaging and its fixed work cycle satisfying despite repetition, while others find limited ship variety and imposed narrative downtime restrictive.

dossiers.title: Dordogne

corroborators.value: UN JE NE SAIS QUOI; UMANIMATION

dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 8 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: Players describe light exploratory interaction around keepsakes, sound recording, photographs, stickers and assembly of a scrapbook rather than complex puzzles.
Hand-painted watercolor locations, music and evocative presentation are the most consistently celebrated aspects of the game's nostalgic atmosphere.
The experience is a short, substantially linear chapter-based journey, commonly completed in about three to four hours with small explorable spaces.
Gentle everyday interactions are soothing to some players; others feel mini-games interrupt the flow or make the overall experience too slight.
Several player reports describe clumsy direction-sensitive mouse inputs and awkward controls for simple everyday-object mini-games.
Mimi's recovered memories of her grandmother and family tensions frame the story; responses differ on whether the accessible writing is affecting or underdeveloped.
Words, recordings and stickers can be collected and arranged in a journal, providing optional discovery within otherwise linear advancement.
The activity structure has little demand for puzzle mastery or mechanical difficulty; exploration and optional collection matter more than solving obstacles.

conflicts.statement: Short duration and simple storytelling are praised as focused and moving by some players and criticized as superficial with limited replay value by others.

dossiers.title: Maitetsu:Last Run!!
dossiers.summary: Evidence summary: 10 validated structured observations; consult observations and conflicts for supported findings.

observations.statement: The player experience is a lengthy voiced and animated visual novel with story routes rather than demanding real-time action, combat or management.
Players across language communities particularly praise the rich E-mote/Live2D facial animation and expressive character illustrations.
Individual character lines, an overarching narrative and extensive new afterstories create a substantial reading volume, including a China-centered scenario.
Even favorable reviewers describe the very long script and everyday-life scenes as occasionally slow or overextended, requiring patience.
Railway heritage and efforts to revitalize a rural region ground the stories, while individual lines explore affection, loss, recovery and personal growth.
Character relationships and emotional payoffs receive sustained praise, alongside occasional disagreement over story choices and believability.
Unlocking and finishing many character lines and later episodes is the main completion task, with a player reporting roughly 56 hours for all achievements.
One detailed player review complains of visible noise in some static illustration assets even while complimenting animated artwork and music.
Some reviewers find the protagonist implausibly capable or specific plot developments contrived despite overall enthusiasm for the cast.
Music and voice performances are praised as key supports for the long-form character drama.

conflicts.statement: The extended route structure creates emotional depth and a large amount of content for some readers, while others regard lengthy everyday passages and uneven plot turns as a trade-off.
